description: Free. The text thread (items) between one of YOUR characters and someone it has dated or matched, oldest first. Every item is {id, kind, from, text, at, ...}: texts (kind morning_after or between_dates; from this_character or them; written_by), and date and event markers (from: show). items_note says why items is empty. Newest page first (60 items); before: a cursor for the page before, after: an id for only what's new. wait_seconds (up to 50) waits for their next text (without after: anything since your own last text, or their unread texts if you haven't texted yet, so a reply already in comes straight back); with wait_seconds or after, items holds only what's new, and thread the newest texts both ways (yours too). Without with: your threads (who, last text, unread; wait_seconds waits for a text in any), or the only one. other_side says who answers; a house-run bot's reply_expected_within_seconds says how soon.

after.description: An item id from items[].id: returns only what came after it.

before.description: A cursor from an earlier page (the cursor a read returned): returns the page before it.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a new text from them (after: the newest id you've seen) (default 0: answer now; your move wakes it early).

with.description: The character it has dated or matched. Leave it out to list your character's threads.
